title: Audit Committee - March 31, 2026
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public

Public Notices English - Hybrid Standing Committee 2025 (AODA).pdf

agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on April 8, 2026 in Audit Committee Report 16.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on March 30, 2026, and the deadline to register to speak by email is 8:30 am on March 31, 2026.

motions.motion_text: BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Audit Committee approve the addition of the following reports, dated March 30, 2026, and published after the agenda, pursuant to subsection 89(3) of the Procedure By-law (being by-law no. 2025-100) to allow for consideration of these matters:

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation(s)

attachments.attachment_title: Report - OAG Semi-annual Report on Follow-up Procedures.pdf
4.2 Document 1 - OAG Semi-Annual Report on Follow-up Procedures EN (AODA).pdf
4.2 Document 1 - OAG Semi-Annual Report on Follow-up Procedures FR (AODA).pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Nathalie Gougeon, Auditor General, and Joanne Gorenstein, Deputy Auditor General, presented an overview of the report and answered questions from the Committee. A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Wendy Stephanson, City Manager, Cyril Rogers, General Manager, Finance and Corporate Services, and Chief Financial Officer, also answered questions from Committee.
There were no submissions on this item.
Following discussions, the Committee considered the report recommendation(s) as follows:

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation(s)
That the Audit Committee recommend Council receive the Semi-Annual Report on Follow-up Procedures.
